about:
Widener Metals, Inc. operates from Fallsington, Pennsylvania, and has served Southeastern Pennsylvania and New Jersey since 2013. The business is locally owned, family-owned, and veteran-owned.

The company stocks a range of metals including structural steel, aluminum, stainless steel, and expanded metal in forms such as I-beams, tubing, and perforated sheet. It adds value through saw cutting, plasma cutting, shearing, punching, bending, priming, and painting services. The shop offers same-day or next-day service and will cut material while customers wait.

Customers span construction, manufacturing, transportation, and general industrial sectors, as well as walk-in retail buyers. The company notes projects ranging from large-scale construction to a middle-school science demonstration requiring a one-inch steel bar.

Widener Metals emphasizes its 35-plus years of industry experience, veteran-owned status, and a commitment to customer satisfaction. It differentiates itself with no minimum order charges, same-day or next-day fulfillment, and in-store pickup and delivery options.
